name: Luna Demian, Tremere Regent of San Francisco

system.concept: Tremere Regent and Thaumaturgical researcher, creator of the Ward Versus Cathayans
system.title: Regent
system.biography:
Background

Embraced in 1760 by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} Pontifex Eve Cavanant, who recognized her exceptional intellect, Luna Demian devoted herself to cloistered magical research rather than clan politics — a choice that advanced her scholarship but left her powerless to avoid an unwanted reassignment to San Francisco as Regent. She transferred her resentment over that reassignment onto the Kuei-jin, and it was Demian who developed the Ward Versus Cathayans ritual that the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} used to seal off the Cathayan Free Zone.

Roleplaying Hints

Demian has little patience for social niceties, preferring to conduct research on captured Kuei-jin subjects, and is chillingly polite when interrupted. Paranoid since her transfer, she surrounds herself with five to twelve armed ghoul decoys dressed in her exact likeness, coordinated by two-way radio at the suggestion of her protégé Martin Franckel.
system.notes: Sire: Eve Cavanant. Protégé: Martin Franckel. Disciplines (as printed): Auspex 5, Celerity 2, Dominate 5, Fortitude 4, Obfuscate 3, Presence 1, Serpentis 1, Thaumaturgy 5 (Path of Blood 5, Path of Shadowcrafting 5, Lure of Flames 3, Hands of Destruction 3, Path of the Levinbolt 5, Spirit Manipulation 2). Rituals include the Ward Versus Cathayans, known otherwise only to Franckel and the Las Vegas Chantry.

items.name: Thaumaturgy (Path of Blood) — 3 Advanced — Cauldron of Blood

system.description: By winning a Physical Challenge to grasp your target, you spend up to three Mental Traits to boil that many of the victim's Blood Traits, each inflicting one level of aggravated damage.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

items.name: Thaumaturgy (Path of Blood) — 2 Intermediate — Blood of Potency

system.description: By concentrating your vitae for the scene or an hour, you spend two Mental Traits per generation (up to three generations) to gain a temporary, more potent virtual generation, raising your Blood Trait maximum and Dominate's reach.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

items.name: Thaumaturgy (Path of Blood) — 2 Intermediate — Theft of Vitae

system.description: By seeing a subject within fifty feet and spending up to three Mental Traits, you win a challenge of Mental versus their Physical Traits to pull that many Blood Traits from their body into your own at range.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: Originally used to lead warrior-caste mystics on vision quests, this vizier technique lets a willing seer bring companions with him into the astral realms. All would-be participants must form an unbroken chain of physical contact with the character. Spend a Blood Trait for each "follower" you wish to bring along, up to a maximum of half your permanent Mental Traits (rounded down), then leave your body as per Psychic Projection. Each follower is treated as though she knows Psychic Projection regardless of her actual Auspex rating, using the leader's rolled successes. On the astral plane, followers must remain within roughly 100 feet of the leader, tethered to him and unable to break the connection. Any follower who loses physical contact with the leader instantly returns to her body and loses three Mental Traits, falling unconscious for the rest of the night if this reduces her to zero Mental Traits.
system.bloodCost: 1 Blood Trait per follower (max half permanent Mental Traits, rounded down)

system.description:
A character with this power instinctively understands what one other person in a conversation (living or undead) wants to hear. If she can find a way to phrase what she wants so that it sounds like what that person wants to hear, this helps her get her point across, ingratiate herself, or accumulate favors. Unlike Telepathy, the subject need not be actively thinking about what she wants to hear.

The character must spend at least a minute speaking with the subject and win a Mental Challenge against the subject. If both players agree, they may instead roleplay the conversation directly, with the subject's player reacting favorably and offering suggestions that aid the character with the power. If the players resort to mechanics, the character with the power initiates a Social Challenge against the subject, winning ties.

Doubletalk is a trick passed among the Toreador for centuries. The character speaks a full sentence very quickly and softly, hidden between words spoken normally so that it sounds like a conversational placeholder ('uh,' 'er,' 'hmmm') to most listeners. Someone familiar with the power can pick out the hidden sentence; true masters can compress entire soliloquies into a single grunt. This is not an exclusive secret of the clan — some Tremere and Malkavians have also mastered the technique.

To listen for Doubletalk in a conversation, the player makes a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty five Traits); success means the character hears what was said, while failure means she heard nothing. To speak Doubletalk, the player makes a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty six Traits); success lets the character seamlessly insert the hidden phrase, while failure means she isn't understood. A single challenge suffices for an entire conversation. This power costs five Experience Traits to learn.

Rather than requiring eye contact, you may use Dominate through skin-to-skin contact alone (a Physical Challenge may be needed on unwilling subjects). The touch need not be maintained while issuing the command, but only one command may be given per contact; using Dominate again requires touching the subject anew.

Commands you implant via Dominate become extremely resistant to being overridden by other vampires. Any other Dominate user attempting to countermand your instruction on the subject must spend an extra Willpower Trait and bid two extra Traits on the test.
system.duration: As long as the original command stands

items.name: Dominate — 3 Advanced — Speak Through the Blood

system.description: Spend a permanent Willpower Trait and win a Mental Challenge against any vampire of your own bloodline, regardless of distance, to implant a broad, generic long-term command (specific or immediate orders are not possible). The command lasts five years per permanent Willpower Trait spent, gradually shaping the subject's agenda without her realizing the source, and combines potently with powers like Mass Manipulation. A vampire who reaches Golconda becomes immune, though unknowingly so.
system.duration: Five years per permanent Willpower Trait

system.description: A combination power blending Potence's unnatural strength with Fortitude's supernatural toughness, letting a Cainite brace her whole body against blunt-force impacts: falling, car crashes, explosions, or being struck by very large objects. It does not help against ordinary combat damage (fists, bullets, blades) or against fire, electricity, sunlight, or other energy-based damage — only against impacts affecting the entire body, and only if the character can see the impact coming and brace for it.
system.source: Mexico City by Night, Chapter Five: Storytelling (Unique Abilities)

system.description: When you suffer lethal or bashing damage, you may make a Simple Test (improved by spending a stamina-related Physical Trait) to remove one level of that damage entirely; usable once per attack, and may be combined with Resilience.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

vtmlarp.source: San Francisco by Night, Chapter Five: Honored Shen
